regressions.what: hero_night: lower-left 40% of the frame is black (5,5,6) where r3 had a lamp pool (75,65,55). The sightline fix deleted the promenade lamp near the spawn, so the lamp map lost its splat and the player stands at the edge of darkness.
hero: player luma 49.6 -> 42.2. The lit glare patch now clips at 250 and pulls auto-exposure down, so the back-lit hoodie reads as a silhouette again despite the new uCharFill day term.

hero / hero_back: the opening plaza is emptier. The bench (benches are spawned with every 2nd lamp, so removing the lamp removed its bench), both foreground palms (palm exclusion > 9 m from spawn) and 2-3 peds are gone. Cleaner, but less lived-in.
hero_night: unlit tower cladding is brighter than in r3 (left tower 94,100,117 -> 117,121,133). It reads even more as daylit slabs.
Desktop cost: hero_back +51% calls (1084 -> 1635) and mends +52% calls (322 -> 491) / +33% tris with no visible change.
hero shadow pavers darker and still brown (55,41,35 -> 44,34,32), not the blue-grey that was targeted.

fixes.area: night light pool at the spawn
fixes.problem: hero_night foreground is black (5,5,6; luma_p5 3.0). sightOK() in props.js line 205 drops every promenade lamp within 3 m of the first half of the spawn-to-bridge line. That lamp was the only light-map splat on the player's paving, so the opening night frame now shows the player on a black void. Its paired bench went with it (benchM is pushed only with lamps).
fixes.fix: Move the lamp instead of deleting it. In the alongShore loop (props.js line 206), when !sightOK(x,z), offset the point 5 m along the shore tangent (p[2]) and re-test, and push it only if the new spot passes. Also always splat the original position into the lamp light-map (a light-only entry in a separate lampSplat[] array used by the splat loop at line 217), so the pool stays even if no pole is placed. Push the bench regardless of the lamp test (decouple bi++ from sightOK).

SIGHT_BLOCKED_LAMP: shift 5 m along shore + keep light splat

fixes.problem: Better than r3 but still navy. street_sgt road is (31,42,64) with B/R 2.06 and frame sat 0.388, shops road is (31,39,59), and shadowed lawn is black-green. The fill is now brighter (env 1.15), but it is still saturated blue: zenith [0.05,0.14,0.40] baked into the PMREM, plus grade.splitShadow [0.87,0.98,1.13] adds more blue. GTA VI shade is neutral blue-grey at mid luma.
fixes.fix: (1) art.js grade.splitShadow [0.87,0.98,1.13] to [0.93,0.99,1.05]. (2) sky.js env-bake branch only: col = mix(vec3(dot(col, vec3(0.2126,0.7152,0.0722))), col, 0.6) for the upper hemisphere, so the canyon fill is about 40% less blue without changing the visible sky. (3) daycycle.js K el 20 amax 1.8 to 2.2 (hero meters bright, so it is unaffected).

fixes.area: empty streets and plaza (traffic + peds in frame)
fixes.problem: street_sgt and shops still show zero cars and zero people. T.prime() calls spawn() T.target times on random lanes across the whole network, filtered only by 30-300 m. Most spawns land behind or off-axis, and at SwiftShader fps the 8 s wait barely moves them. peds.js has no CBD loop at all (LOOPS eq/landing/west/barrack/south only), so St Georges Tce can never have pedestrians. GTA VI streets are full; this is the single biggest 'demo' tell.
fixes.fix: traffic.js T.prime(near): build a candidate list of lanes with any point within 160 m of near, and accept points with 20 m <= dist <= 160 m and dot(p - cam, camForward) > 0. Spawn 0.6*T.target there (force distance rules, keep the 14 m spacing). peds.js: add LOOPS.sgt, two footpath polylines along St Georges Tce (offset r.w/2 + 1.2 from the road centreline between x -450..650, z -150..-900), with busy ? 12 : 5 walkers. game/index.js: parked kerb cluster [-60,-560,10] on high.

fixes.area: backlit player silhouette in the hero frame
fixes.problem: hero player luma fell from 49.6 to 42.2, close to the 40 floor. The glare patch right of the player clips at (250,227,192) and drives exposure down, and uCharFill 0.07*back*day is too small to offset it. The player's feet also have no visible contact shadow against the backlit pavers, so they look slightly floating.
fixes.fix: daycycle.js line 124: 0.07*back*day to 0.12*back*day. avatars.js fill: max(diffuseColor.rgb, vec3(0.07))*uCharFill (floor for near-black cloth). Add a 0.55 m radius soft blob decal under the player and peds, strength 0.35 and multiplied by day (cookbook/decals), so the feet seat. surfaces.js eq_pavers: raise roughness so the glare patch peaks around 225, not 250 (see the P3 glare fix).

fixes.problem: Close up, Kings Park is now good (kings_park is a real eucalypt canopy panorama). From mends and aerial the scarp is still a bald blue-grey hump: aerial (99,101,112), mends hill (119,125,142). Instances fade at 1100-1500 m and the bush floor shader has no distance term (surfaces.js bush, lines 59-75). Not landed from r4.
fixes.fix: Pass view distance into the surface patch (ground.js / the S() ground patch that calls surf(): add a float uniform-free varying vViewDist = length(worldPos - cameraPosition)). In bush(): col = mix(col, vec3(0.05,0.06,0.034) * (0.7 + 0.45*big), smoothstep(800.0, 1400.0, vViewDist)); s.ao = mix(s.ao, 0.7, same). Zero draw calls.

fixes.problem: hero_night: unlit cladding is pale grey and now brighter (117,121,133), three times the sky. The towers read as daylit, not lit by their rooms. Env intensity at night is still 0.80 (daycycle.js lines 32-33), and the facade frame has no night term. Not landed from r4.
fixes.fix: daycycle.js K: el -18 env 0.80 to 0.42, el -8 env 0.80 to 0.55. facade.js after line 106: frame *= mix(1.0, 0.65, uNight * (1.0 - shop)). Lit fraction at line 167: 0.94-0.30*uNight to 0.94-0.38*uNight, so roughly 30% of the floors glow warm.

fixes.problem: street_sgt left and shops left: random pale-blue squares scattered over cobalt glass, chosen per cell (facade.js line 185). They read as texture noise, not office blinds. Not landed from r4.
fixes.fix: facade.js line 185: blind = step(1.0 - fcH(vec2(floor(cell.x/5.0), cell.y)+4.2)*0.7, f.y) * step(0.62, fcH(vec2(floor(cell.x/5.0), cell.y)+2.3)) * (1.0-shop). Line 186: albedo 0.42 to 0.30 (lit) and 0.25 to 0.18 (unlit).

fixes.problem: Now that the arches are clear, the hero frame's left 45% is empty paving and sky. Both foreground palm trunks, the bench and the peds were stripped (palm exclusion > 9 m from spawn at props.js line 179; bench tied to the removed lamp). The frame reads as an empty test plaza, not the lived-in EQ promenade the bible describes.
fixes.fix: Keep the palm exclusion, but place one Washingtonia 7-8 m left of the spawn on the shore side, so it frames at screen x 0.08-0.18 and its crown fills the upper-left sky: an explicit palm point in the EQ palm list, outside the sightOK corridor. Restore the bench (see P0). Bias 3 of the eq ped loop spawns within 25 m of PLAYER_SPAWN at boot (peds.js line 45).

fixes.problem: mends skyline (149,150,162) on sky (175,171,175): dL is about 23, still a pale ghost against kpview's dark glass. kings_park also has milky haze over the CBD. river_cbd and aerial depth is good.
fixes.fix: art.js fog.sigma [0.00015,0.00021,0.00034] to [0.00011,0.00015,0.00025]. sunInscatter 0.95 to 0.85. Keep scatter and start. Check that river_cbd keeps its warm haze toward the sun.

fixes.problem: street_sgt right and shops left: the street level is a row of flat pale grey panels under a coloured fascia stripe. These are the nearest architecture to the player. By day the interior gain (line 182: shop 0.9*lampC*(0.45+...)) washes the 4.5 m room into a flat card.
fixes.fix: facade.js line 182: shop day gain 0.9 to 0.45 at uNight 0 (keep 0.9*(0.45+2.6*uNight) at night). Add 0.08 m dark mullions every 1.6 m inside the 0.3-3.3 m bay band, and a 0.15 m dark transom at 2.6 m. Add a 0.6 m awning slab over shop bays (one merged box per building in towers.js) for a real shadow line.

fixes.area: mid/far tower facades and low-rise boxes
fixes.problem: bridge_skyline is almost identical to r3. The right-centre pair and the podiums go flat once cells are sub-pixel. aerial is still a field of untextured beige boxes, with no rooftop plant on low-rise blocks. Not landed from r4.
fixes.fix: facade.js far branch (far = smoothstep(0.08,0.30,fcFoot), line 52): add a floor-slab term avg = mix(avg, avg*0.86, 0.12/fh) with weight (1-smoothstep(0.6,1.5,fw.y)), and a vertical gradient avg *= mix(0.88, 1.06, vFUv.y/towerH). towers.js line 99: give footprints over 400 m2 plant boxes (2-4 boxes, 2-3 m high).

fixes.problem: phone_hud is 2.25M tris / 418 calls, a real drop from 3.73M but still above the 2.0M / 400 target. The planar mirror redraws to maxFar 2600 on every tier (index.js line 91), and every car casts shadows (vehicles.js line 117).
fixes.fix: index.js line 91: refl.maxFar = tier low ? 1400 : 2600. vehicles.js line 117: castShadow only when tier != 'low' or the distance to focus is under 35 m (check in traffic update every 0.5 s). Add userData.noReflect to traffic and ped roots on low.

fixes.problem: hero_back: the largest hard edge in the frame is still a flat pale 0.06 m wedge running into the water (ground.js line 288 copingGeo(r, 0.55, 0.06)). tricia1 shows the rounded 0.4 m limestone seat edge.
fixes.fix: ground.js line 288: copingGeo(r, 0.62, 0.40), with a 0.12 m rounded nose (3-segment bevel in copingGeo) and a 0.35 m dark wet band at the waterline (albedo *0.45, roughness 0.15).

fixes.area: noon pavers and inlet water colour
fixes.problem: hero_noon: the pavers are a pale grey high-contrast checkerboard, the brightest large area in the frame. hero water is milky lilac (99,90,91) where the bible asks for #2A566E deep teal.
fixes.fix: surfaces.js line 21: lime 0.13 to 0.115, granite 0.105 to 0.095, dark 0.075 to 0.07. Mix share step(0.72,h1) to step(0.80,h1), so fewer pale pavers. Water: raise the body/absorption colour weight toward vec3(0.03,0.075,0.10) where the reflection is not mirror-dominant (Fresnel below 0.3).

fixes.problem: phone_hud: the right buttons are clear, but there is still nothing bottom-left to show where to move (ui.css has no joystick ghost). The bars only calm after 4 s, so the boot frame shows full bars over the far shore.
fixes.fix: ui.css body.touch: a resting joystick ghost bottom-left (88 px ring, 2 px rgba(255,255,255,.35), 28 px dot rgba(255,255,255,.18)) that fades to .15 after the first move. hud.js line 139: calmT > 4 to calmT > 2.

fixes.problem: aerial: the west plateau still shows horizontal terrace bands. These are uint8 height steps (map.js line 78, KPD Uint8Array) on 8 m texels.
fixes.fix: map.js line 78: decode to a Float32Array and run one separable 5-tap Gaussian (sigma 1.2 texels) before the bilinear lookup at line 82. One-time cost at boot.

fixes.problem: hero_back calls went 1084 to 1635 (+51%) and mends calls 322 to 491 / tris 4.47M to 5.97M. The frames show no visible change. Likely causes: the restored plane avenue and palms entering the shadow and reflection passes (not in the NR list), and the new palm skirt cards.
fixes.fix: Log renderer.info per pass in shoot.mjs (main / mirror / shadow). Add the EQ palm scatter group to the NR list for the mirror pass beyond 250 m. Set the street-tree shadow cast fade to 220 m. Target: hero_back back to 1100 calls or fewer.

fixes.area: sun glare clipping on plaza / jetty boards
fixes.problem: hero: the sunlit paver glare clips at (250,227,192) over a large patch. It is the brightest value in frame, at the image centre-right rather than on the focal subject. mends: jetty boards read about 0.6-0.8 m wide. The shelter is a flat grey box.
fixes.fix: surfaces.js line 110: eq_pavers roughness 0.9 to 0.94 (glare peak about 225). index.js line 46: timberDeck uv scale x1.4 (boards about 0.15 m). Give the jetty shelter a white steel frame + glass material instead of the solid grey panel.

notes: Real progress this round: the arches are now clear in the opening frame, the palm streamers are gone, the St Georges plane avenue is back, kings_park is a near-kpview panorama, and the phone budget dropped 40%. Against a GTA VI frame, though, the city is still empty (0 cars / 0 peds on both CBD streets), shade is still navy, the night opener regressed to a black foreground, and close facades and shopfronts still read procedural. river_cbd and kings_park are the strongest frames (close to 7). street_sgt and hero_night are the weakest.
